title: Public Institutions of Higher Education – Pregnant and Parenting Students – Plan and Reporting
material_provisions: Maryland Higher Education Commission must collect student-level parental status data from public institutions
Excludes University of Maryland Global Campus from parental status data collection
Community colleges (not all public institutions) must adopt support plans for pregnant and parenting students
Public senior higher education institutions AND community colleges must post plans by October 1, 2026
Parental status added to Maryland Longitudinal Data System
Pregnancy status explicitly excluded from student data
Annual reports to legislature starting September 1, 2027

adopted_amendments.original: all public institutions of higher education
adopted_amendments.significance: Narrows which institutions must adopt support plans

adopted_amendments.change: Excludes University of Maryland Global Campus from definition of public institution
adopted_amendments.significance: Exempts one institution from data collection requirements

adopted_amendments.change: Extends plan requirement from senior institutions only to community colleges as well

required_facts: Commission collects parental status data from public institutions
University of Maryland Global Campus is excluded
Community colleges must adopt support plans
Public senior institutions AND community colleges must post plans
Parental status included in student data
Pregnancy status excluded from student data
prohibited_claims: All public institutions must adopt plans (WRONG - only community colleges)
University of Maryland Global Campus must collect data (WRONG - explicitly excluded)
Deadline is August 1, 2026 (WRONG - changed to October 1)
Only senior institutions affected (WRONG - community colleges also)
Pregnancy status is student data (WRONG - explicitly excluded)
No exclusions exist (WRONG - UMGC is excluded)

critical_distinctions.scope_narrowing: Support plan requirement changed from 'all public institutions' to 'community colleges only' - this is a major scope reduction visible via strikethrough
critical_distinctions.umgc_exclusion: University of Maryland Global Campus explicitly excluded from parental status data collection mandate
critical_distinctions.dual_requirement: Both senior institutions AND community colleges must post plans (expanded coverage)
critical_distinctions.data_distinction: Parental status IS student data; pregnancy status is NOT
critical_distinctions.date_extension: Posting deadline extended from August to October 2026

agencies_affected: All public institutions of higher education (for data collection)
Public senior higher education institutions (for support plans)
University of Maryland Global Campus (explicitly excluded)
strikethrough_test_cases: ~~all~~ ~~public~~ ~~institutions~~ ~~of~~ ~~higher~~ ~~education~~ community colleges - must accurately reflect this scope change
